Hourly momentum.roc_5d is already -3.5% (rolling over) while daily ADX 27.55 with +DI 34.8 still says strong trend, so the asymmetric risk is a multi-day mean-reversion pullback toward the 20EMA at 361.61 (-12% from 409.99).

R:R ~ 2.5:1 only if you hold to fib extension, but daily ATR 4.21% means stop can get hit on a single average-range red bar without thesis violation.

Volume quality is mixed, not confirming a clean breakout. Daily volume.relative_volume = 1.74 today, but pivot_highs at 397.4 had only 2 tests (volume_confirmed=true) and the prior 11-test pivot at 371.0 was NOT volume_confirmed — there is no deep, well-tested supply zone above to trust as a launchpad. On the hourly, relative_volume = 0.96 (below average), and hourly RSI is only 58.06 vs daily RSI 65.37 — short-term momentum is already cooling while daily looks hot, the classic distribution-into-strength signature. With Q1 already reported 2026-05-05 (positive but now backward-looking) and next earnings 92 days out, the catalyst is exhausted into the move.
